crossRefs.note: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven…
For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…
As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her…
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any…

people.name: Simon
people.line: A man in Bethany who hosted Jesus for a meal.

translations.web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
translations.bsb: “I suppose the one who was forgiven more,” Simon replied. “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.
translations.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
translations.asv: Simon answered and said, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
